views.label: Follow the String
views.note: Follow the same String through the program in the 3D lab. A move changes its owner, not its heap bytes.

views.label: Understand the move
views.note: show(name) transfers ownership to message. name cannot be used again, and no second String allocation is created.

views.label: Watch the cleanup
views.note: Printing borrows message. Returning from show drops it, releases its bytes, and resumes main with count still available.

lanes.label: One String, from creation to cleanup

transitions.note: show(name) transfers the String from name to the parameter message without cloning its heap allocation.
println! temporarily borrows message to read the bytes. message remains the owner.
At the end of show, message goes out of scope and its String is dropped.
Dropping this String releases its allocation. No garbage-collection pass is needed.
Moving name into show makes the old binding unavailable. This is a compile-time rule, not a runtime flag.
After message is dropped and show returns, main prints count. The moved String does not automatically return to name.
